text_block_list.text: Wait... What was that just now?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
What is this heat? It feels like something

incredible is welling up from deep within
me. I
can't put it into words...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But this sensation is nicht schlecht. No,
it's not
bad at all. In fact, it's rather
pleasant.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
